must_fix.finding: The stop subprocess and subsequent cleanup can raise inside finally before LAUNCH_RECEIPT is written. A pg_ctl stop timeout therefore both loses the final error record and may leave this task PostgreSQL running.
must_fix.required: Always persist final receipt after an independently caught cleanup error; make bounded task-owned shutdown fallback or explicitly record confirmed still-running/unknown status and block any further scientific work. Never report stopped absent confirmation.
